concerns.text: FR-004 requires using MaAsLin2 (or equivalent linear model) on CLR‑transformed taxon abundances. MaAsLin2 already performs its own log‑ratio transformation; applying an additional CLR step may violate the model’s assumptions and constitute double‑transformation of compositional data.

SC-001 asks for a Spearman ρ together with a standard error. Spearman correlation is a non‑parametric rank statistic; a closed‑form standard error is not defined. Reporting a standard error would require bootstrapping or other resampling, which is not specified, making the success criterion ambiguous.
